title: Interpolation inequality for the uniform norm
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p,q,\theta\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $p>0$, $q>0$, $0<\theta<1$, and $\frac12=\frac{\theta}{p}+\frac{1-\theta}{q}$. For every $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, the uniform norms satisfy $\|f\|_2^2\le \|f\|_p^{2\theta}\|f\|_q^{2(1-\theta)}$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a real-valued function on Ω
